requiredFindings.title: Bind the accepted feature graph by resolution, activation, and lawful use
requiredFindings.detail: The metadata predicate compares only selected package names, canonical manifest paths, and textual feature maps; its accepted fixture has no dependencies or resolve graph. It therefore cannot prove that forwarding aliases resolve to the intended packages or that guarded features are not enabled directly from ordinary dependency declarations. The production scan also rejects only the literal cfg(feature spelling, so cfg(any(feature = ...)), cfg_attr, and token-separated forms can reuse an accepted feature for an unauthorized doctor selector outside the exact outcomes prefix. Bind each forwarding alias through the selected resolve nodes to the intended canonical targets, reject direct ordinary-dependency activation, constrain production feature gates to the exact accepted uses, and add pure controls plus compiled runtime mutations for those conditions.
